programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the ‘Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: 血滴子
programme.desc: 马腾是雍正的密令组织「血滴子特务团」的其中一位杀手。当马腾质疑其特务行动是否有违道义时，却旋即变成被同伴追捕的逃犯。

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: 万花迎春
programme.desc: 歌舞团台柱陈君迈赋闲多时后，应征当富家女梅倩如的司机，竟被误传恋情。倩如为查明流言的来源，假扮记者采访歌舞团，期间君迈与倩如暗生好感，经过一番试探后，二人终一舞定情。

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the "Sun and Moon" secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and two beautiful Uyghur princesses, leaving him caught between his duty and their devotion.

programme.title: 儒侠
programme.desc: 年轻剑客沈秉义受命出任爱国组织「日月会」总舵主，誓要讨伐勾结外敌、祸国殃民的大将军。在舍身报国的征途中，他先后邂逅豪爽女侠与两位美若天仙的维族公主。面对国仇家恨与三段缠绵深情，这位剑客陷入了情义两难的抉择。

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: 大军阀
programme.desc: 一名土匪因助俄国抗击日本而成为北方的大军阀。由于他好大喜功又目不识丁，老百姓当他是个大笑话。后来，当年曾被他无端杀死的戏班老板之女出现，枪杀了这个卖国贼。

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi. At the same time, he is assigned by a revolutionary group to steal the valuable "Sutra of 42 Chapters," which Emperor Kang Xi himself is also seeking. Demonstrating keen intelligence, Xiao Bao deftly navigates between opposing factions and successfully evades danger.

programme.title: 鹿鼎记
programme.desc: 小宝阴差阳错地闯入宫廷，意外成为康熙皇帝的好友。此时，他又受到天地会的命令，必须窃取极为重要的四十二章经，而康熙皇帝本人也在追查其下落。聪明的小宝在两方敌对势力之间周旋，最终凭藉聪明才智成功脱险。

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: 宝莲灯
programme.desc: 这是一个耳熟能详之中国民间神话故事，讲述书生刘彦昌巧遇落入凡间的圣母三娘，二人一见钟情，结下一段仙凡姻缘。但因与二郎神结怨，屡遭迫害，二郎神更将圣母压在华山底下。彦昌与圣母之子沉香长大后，闻悉生母被压华山，悲愤欲绝，藉神斧之助挫败二郎神，劈山救母。

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: 千王斗千霸
programme.desc: 名震赌坛的千王与其拍档受命调查一位上海赌界大亨，怀疑其以赌场为掩护从事间谍活动。两人深入危机四伏的赌局世界，在层层布局与试探中步步为营，与强敌展开一场关乎生死与荣耀的斗智对决。

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: 万古流芳
programme.desc: 晋灵公宠信奸佞屠岸贾，时边关告急，相国赵盾启奏，反被屠岸贾挑拨，下令斩杀赵家三百余口。幸程婴抱庄姬之子赵武出走。屠下令杀全国男婴以断后患，程不惜以己子代替。赵长大，程以“雪冤图”告之，杀一家三百口仇人乃屠岸贾，更安排他与母亲相认......

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: 英雄无泪
programme.desc: 江湖异人萧大师铸成宝剑「泪痕剑」，不料该剑显现出凶兆，将会带来武林浩劫，而他的亲生子注定要死在此剑之下。萧为了使此剑不危害江湖，将它交给一位淡薄名利的弟子保管。数十年后该弟子把它传给门徒小高，令其带剑下山望化解江湖劫数。

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: One of Shaw Studio's highest grossing movies ever, this is the story of Li Chin Huan, the renowned, charming and sentimental swordsman who must fight many opponents, including an evil Clan Chief, for a place in the martial arts world.

programme.title: 魔剑侠情
programme.desc: 狄龙扮演的小李悄然回到爱侣故园之旁隐居，遥对窗中倩影，而不相见，直至发生危机，小李才露面相告，并且挺身赴难。有不少高手为争“武林排名”而找小李决斗，小李又要对付恶势力庞大的帮主谷峰，于是小李找寻旧友阿飞相助，但阿飞被阴险美女林仙儿所迷，简直变成废人，小李于是揭破这女人的假面目，并且设法使阿飞振作起来。

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fête. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: 花田错
programme.desc: 故事讲述千金小姐刘月英与丫鬟春兰同游花田盛会，邂逅桥边画画的落拓书生卞济。春兰眼见小姐芳心暗许，于是穿针引线，欲促成良缘，却因老家仆错认小霸王周通为卞济，使小姐与卞济情路波折重重。在经过一连串误会与错配后，结局乃皆大欢喜。

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: 十三太保
programme.desc: 故事讲述于唐朝年间，沙陀国主有十三义子，皆获太保衔。姜大卫饰演的十三太保为战场精英，因而引起兄弟间的嫉妒及挑拨离间，最后更演变成兄弟相残。

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: 神经大侠
programme.desc: 威力无敌的兵器鸳鸯刀将要送给满清的皇帝，却不慎落入萧中慧和袁冠南手里。大内高手卓天雄于是出发追捕二人，誓要取回鸳鸯刀。大战一触即发，此刻鸳鸯刀的秘密也同被揭开。

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her family's massacre years ago.

programme.title: 冰天侠女
programme.desc: 沈冰红幼时目击父母遭高允及结拜弟兄杀害，双脚更被冻至残废；长大后练就非凡武功，矢志复仇。后冰红与高允次子高天英结识，天英虽知冰红为报仇而来，却对她的遭遇非常同情，主动为她治好脚疾……

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: 除暴安良
programme.desc: 三名持枪劫匪抢劫了一批正在运送的新发行货币，刑警常勇奉命展开调查。随着线索逐渐浮现，常勇成功击毙一名劫匪。然而，其他两名劫匪不甘就此罢手，乘乱密谋抢劫金厂的黄金。常勇凭藉精密的部署，成功粉碎了他们的计划，将不法分子绳之以法。

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: 千王斗千霸
programme.desc: 名震赌坛的千王与其拍档受命调查一位上海赌界大亨，怀疑其以赌场为掩护从事间谍活动。两人深入危机四伏的赌局世界，在层层布局与试探中步步为营，与强敌展开一场关乎生死与荣耀的斗智对决。

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes…

programme.title: 我爱罗兰度
programme.desc: Lolanto自命风流，一次因伤入院结识了富商的弱智独生女儿阿蚊，她如小孩般天真可爱，渐渐更与Lolanto成为好友。蚊父因此聘请Lolanto来照顾她。不久，蚊入院做智力恢复手术，但恢复智力后的阿蚊与Lolanto建立的情谊却黯然离去…

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: 倾城之恋
programme.desc: 本片由香港导演许鞍华执导，改编自著名小说家张爱玲的同名小说，是一个发生在日军入侵香港期间的爱情故事。一个内向的上海离婚女子和一个愤世嫉俗的马来西亚花花公子互相倾慕。但因时局动荡，两人多次被迫分开，最终能否有情人终成眷属?

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: 三十处男
programme.desc: 设计师赵宇庭被批算三十岁前结婚，会被妻子克死，赵父遂严禁赵宇庭结交异性。但限期将届，他急不及待觅对象。荔玲与母亲同为死人化妆师，为了交男友改为新娘化妆，此时她认识了赵宇庭...

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: 拳击小子
programme.desc: 以行船为生的前拳手提早退休，重回香港，遇上青年。青年因追求老板妹妹而与货运少东起冲突，并将少东打伤。他们约定三个月后双方擂台打拳以定强弱...

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: 审死官
programme.desc: 周星驰饰演著名状师宋世杰，经常不择手段为富人打赢官司，让他们逍遥法外，因此妻子迫使他退隐乡间。然而，当宋夫人结识一位丈夫之死被贪官掩盖的妇人时，宋世杰决定挺身而出，再次在公堂上伸张正义，为她讨回公道。

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: 西游记第壹百零壹回之月光宝盒
programme.desc: 逍遥山贼斧头帮帮主至尊宝，意外得知自己是孙悟空的转世。随着妖魔与仙界势力逼近，他被卷入月光宝盒引发的时空混乱之中。在爱恨纠葛与不可违抗宿命之间，他必须在凡人身份与救世重任中作出抉择。

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: 回魂夜
programme.desc: 老妇神秘堕楼死亡，鬼魂于回魂夜当晚出现作祟。弄得一众大厦保安员不得安宁，并邀请了捉鬼大师Leo与女助手相助。Leo从老妇鬼魂得知，她是被儿子及媳妇所杀害，为了让老妇安息，Leo答应将夫妇二人绳之以法...

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: 大内密探零零发
programme.desc: 零零发是宫廷四大高手之一，专职保卫皇帝的安全。虽然不谙武功，却有着不寻常的嗜好：打造超越时代的发明。皇上被掳后，他靠着自己的过人发明救驾。

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: 秦明·生死语者
programme.desc: 被誉为“尸语者”的法医秦明常可在尸体身上解剖出重要的线索。在调查一宗谋杀案时，秦明在实习助手和刑警队长的协助下发现了尘封16年的雪山杀人案，同时亦揭发离奇谋杀案背后隐藏着的秘密。

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: 少年陈真之乱世英雄
programme.desc: 电影讲述清末上海的小人物陈真，在经历苦难及面对无数挑战后，蜕变成长为民族英雄的故事。

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: 僵尸叔叔
programme.desc: 偏僻山间，一僧一道比邻而居。和尚（午马 饰）随和开朗，更有一女徒菁菁（李丽珍 饰）玲珑可爱；道士（陈友 饰）古板严厉，而徒弟嘉乐（钱嘉乐 饰）却鬼马顽皮。性格不同的两个师傅口角不断，大斗其法，两个冤家徒弟也搞笑连连，笑料频出。

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: 黑白潜行
programme.desc: 香港警员阿山以卧底身份潜伏在监狱，接近罪犯天哥，以获取其犯罪集团的更多证据。二人获释后，阿山全力帮助天哥扶摇直上，最终使天哥成为集团的主脑。然而，当阿山协助警方顺利摧毁犯罪集团时，他却意外揭开了天哥的一个惊天秘密…

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: 白发鬼
programme.desc: 年轻俊秀，生于名门望族的日籍华人林保，自幼失去父母，与大学好友川村感情深厚。二人都对美少女琉璃子心存爱慕，但川村自怜身世，不敢与林保争夺，林保顺利娶得琉璃子为妻。林保出国公干期间，川村和琉璃子耐不住寂寞，有了奸情。不久之后，林保竟在一次滑雪中意外身亡...

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: 求爱敢死队
programme.desc: 失恋的王晶认识了电台节目主持曾志伟。志伟自诩情场杀手向王晶提供追求秘诀，但当其本身周旋于妻子与情人的关系当中，却不知如何是好...

The program, relying on global reporting resources, presents in-depth analysis and coverage of major global issues, from a Chinese perspective on international affairs. The program presents to-the-point interpretation of Chinese policies and stories that are of interest to foreign audiences, in a style they are familiar with.

programme.title: Country Spirit
programme.desc: KOO SAI LUNG (CHUN PUI) is the manager of a wine factory. He adopts his ex-girlfriend’s illegitimate son, SHUNG (LAM KA TUNG), out of kindness. SHUNG is cheerful and tolerates any kind of abuse. LUNG’s sister, YIU (TANG SHUI MAN), loves SHUNG. However, she cannot forget her former love KOU (TSANG WAI KUEN) who is dead.

programme.title: 酒是故乡醇
programme.desc: 古世龙(秦沛)乃酒厂当家，因顾念情义而收留旧情人的私生子阿纯(林家栋)。纯寄人篱下，饱受屈辱，幸其生性豁达，毫不介意任低微的「酒尾公」。世龙妹古瑶(邓萃雯)处处关怀纯，纯对瑶早生情愫，惜瑶念念不忘已逝世的蒸煮师傅裘真(曾伟权)，不能释怀。世龙独子桂生(马德钟)为国从军，音讯杳然，古家以为其已死，替他安排冥婚，新娘是以拉横水渡为生的黎顺风(佘诗曼)。顺风为人执着、硬朗，与古家上下皆合不来，幸得纯从旁劝解，人才像美酒经过蒸酿般越见醇厚。纯其后拜「火王」金吉祥(元华)为师；祥早期丧妻，与瑶同病相怜，发展成一对斗气冤家。世龙中风，古家内部争权夺利，闹得天翻地覆，风只好以大少奶身分担起当家之位，与纯合力助酒厂渡过难关。二人日久生情，岂料生却于此时突然回家。风已为人妻，纯重情义，二人能否冲破沉重的道德枷锁，以真爱酿出醉人美酒？

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the comp

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: The Airport Diary
programme.desc: Since relocation to Chek Lap Kok in 1998, passenger traffic at Hong Kong International Airport has increased threefold in twenty-five years. And Yeung Sheung-wai (Kenneth Ma), who started out as a clerk, has been promoted to IAC Duty Manager. He is tasked with overseeing the operations of the airport. Sheung-wai also has a contingent of amicable partners, including his assistant-cum-admirer Fong Ho-yee (Rosita Kwok), Lui Chi-shan (Samantha Ko) – who handles airport passenger services – Chan Kit

programme.title: 飞常日志
programme.desc: 香港国际机场自九八年迁往赤鱲角，廿五年来客运量攀升三倍，杨尚伟(马国明饰)亦从小职员晋升为中央控制中心值班经理，负责监察整个机场的运作。尚伟还有一班好伙伴，包括仰慕他的助手方可儿(郭柏姸饰)、负责机场客运服务的吕芷珊(高海宁饰)、负责机场保安的陈杰(洪永城饰)及负责停机坪服务的李胜祥(徐荣饰)，他们合作无间协助处理机场发生的各种事情……尚伟与身为港湾航空驻机场主管的前妻张若玲(蔡思贝饰)常有交集，其实二人离婚后仍想着对方，当中机长郭启光(朱敏瀚饰)和空服员高雅雯(刘颖旋饰)的出现，令二人关系再起波澜。

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN’s bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG’s lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI’s (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne

programme.title: 洪武三十二
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三(徐子珊)和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中……

programme.title: Line Walker
programme.desc: Following the death of his co-worker, CHEUK HOI (Michael Mui) discovers that five undercover officers have lost. All of them possess confidential information. CHEUK HOI needs to find them immediately……

programme.title: 使徒行者
programme.desc: 总督察卓凯(苗侨伟)因战友死亡，发现一直联系的五名卧底全部失踪，由于他们掌握高度机密，卓凯决意追寻，卧底的黑白两道身分交错复杂，人人皆宣称为正义而战，但真正的正义又是谁来主宰？

programme.title: Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: Ever since his childhood, KO TIN-PO (Wong Cho Lam) has tasted a variety of great delicacies, and he is capable of analyzing the food quality and authenticity once he tastes it. But, owing to the decline of his family, he ends up wandering on the street with his servant LEE WAI (Jack Wu), making a living from selling buns. Also due to his gourmet background, he gets to know a street performer KEI MO-SUET (Joey Meng), the most beautiful girl in Peking NIAN RUOBI (Nancy Wu) and teen celebrity che

programme.title: 食为奴
programme.desc: 高天宝(王祖蓝)自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫(胡诺言)流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪(万绮雯)、京城第一美女年若碧(胡定欣)、少女厨神米小鱼(何雁诗)等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛(黄智贤)，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭(林盛斌)，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩(张继聪)策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗……

programme.title: The Offliners
programme.desc: In Hong Kong, investing in finance, real estate and commerce are down-to-earth activities, but rich heiress WONG CHI-FEI (Katy Kung) prefers getting her head in the clouds, cofounding a start-up technology company with her best friend HUI CHING-WAI (Jason Chan). A network hacking incident allows CHI-FEI to have a chance to know how capable IT genius DING SHUN-HEI (Owen Cheung) is, so she invites him to join the company.

programme.title: 坚离地爱坚离地
programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融、地产、商业是「贴地」举动，富二代王子菲(龚嘉欣饰)却偏爱「离地」，与好友许正伟(陈智燊饰)开设初创科技公司。一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希(张振朗饰)的厉害，邀他加入公司。信希是一名「离地」毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱(刘佩钥饰)帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫……子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤(李国麟饰)、弟王梓龙(罗梓龙饰)、信希之妹丁信恩(黄心颖饰)身上！

programme.title: Heart And Greed
programme.desc: LING LAI-YING (Louise Lee) and her husband WONG WING-CHING (Ha Yu) work hard to run their restaurant, eventually turning it into an entrepreneurial success involving real estate investing and business. LAI-YING’s younger brother LING SHING-FUNG (Bosco Wong) even tries to help them get the company listed on the stock market. Initially, WING-CHING does not agree with this. After seeing the century old family print business run by his benefactor HUI NGA-LUN (Joseph Lee), who helped him get acquitte

programme.title: 溏心风暴3
programme.desc: 凌丽荧(李司棋)与丈夫黄永正(夏雨)凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风(黄宗泽)更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟(李国麟)助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华(关菊英)及亲弟梁赞(阮兆祥)大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧(米雪)有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议。可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家(王浩信)与许家独生女许贝儿(岑丽香)相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱(陈敏之)与有妇之夫郑立安(唐文龙)的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文(黄翠如)关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴……

programme.title: Lady Sour
programme.desc: CHO CHING (Myolie Wu) and her mother CHO CHO BAI-YUET (Gigi Wong) lead vagrant lives by practicing medicine everywhere, during which they get to know KAI CHUN (Ron Ng), a man with a skin disease, and their fellow villager, CHIN TUNG (Him Law), respectively. Falling in love with CHIN TUNG at first sight, CHO CHING tries by all means to marry him, unfortunately, the matriarch of the vinegar brewery, CHIN SHEUNG (Alice Chan), thwarts her plan at all costs, because she is still nursing a grudge aga

programme.title: 醋娘子
programme.desc: 曹青(胡杏儿)与母亲曹曹闭月(黄淑仪)结伴行医跑江湖，先后认识了患皮肤病的计准(吴卓羲)和同乡钱通(罗仲谦)，曹青对钱通一见钟情，千方百计嫁入钱家，可惜醋坊当家钱霜(陈炜)因与闭月有积怨对曹青百般阻挠，计准因病治愈献计助曹青得偿所愿，曹青入门后以为一劳永逸，谁料钱通深爱丫环山楂(岑丽香)，曹青乘机搞乱，反令山楂和钱通意外发生关系，钱通纳山楂为妾，令曹青醋意大发，火上加油。突然，一具尸骸被发现，闭月被告谋害亲夫判处死刑，钱家怕名声受损，要求曹青与闭月断绝母女关系，此际，曹青竟发现有「喜」，却惹来一场休妻大行动……

programme.title: Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: Ever since his childhood, KO TIN-PO (Wong Cho Lam) has tasted a variety of great delicacies, and he is capable of analyzing the food quality and authenticity once he tastes it. But, owing to the decline of his family, he ends up wandering on the street with his servant LEE WAI (Jack Wu), making a living from selling buns. Also due to his gourmet background, he gets to know a street performer KEI MO-SUET (Joey Meng), the most beautiful girl in Peking NIAN RUOBI (Nancy Wu) and teen celebrity che

programme.title: 食为奴
programme.desc: 高天宝(王祖蓝)自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫(胡诺言)流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪(万绮雯)、京城第一美女年若碧(胡定欣)、少女厨神米小鱼(何雁诗)等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛(黄智贤)，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭(林盛斌)，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩(张继聪)策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗……

programme.title: The Offliners
programme.desc: In Hong Kong, investing in finance, real estate and commerce are down-to-earth activities, but rich heiress WONG CHI-FEI (Katy Kung) prefers getting her head in the clouds, cofounding a start-up technology company with her best friend HUI CHING-WAI (Jason Chan). A network hacking incident allows CHI-FEI to have a chance to know how capable IT genius DING SHUN-HEI (Owen Cheung) is, so she invites him to join the company.

programme.title: 坚离地爱坚离地
programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融、地产、商业是「贴地」举动，富二代王子菲(龚嘉欣饰)却偏爱「离地」，与好友许正伟(陈智燊饰)开设初创科技公司。一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希(张振朗饰)的厉害，邀他加入公司。信希是一名「离地」毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱(刘佩钥饰)帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫……子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤(李国麟饰)、弟王梓龙(罗梓龙饰)、信希之妹丁信恩(黄心颖饰)身上！

programme.title: Heart And Greed
programme.desc: LING LAI-YING (Louise Lee) and her husband WONG WING-CHING (Ha Yu) work hard to run their restaurant, eventually turning it into an entrepreneurial success involving real estate investing and business. LAI-YING’s younger brother LING SHING-FUNG (Bosco Wong) even tries to help them get the company listed on the stock market. Initially, WING-CHING does not agree with this. After seeing the century old family print business run by his benefactor HUI NGA-LUN (Joseph Lee), who helped him get acquitte

programme.title: 溏心风暴3
programme.desc: 凌丽荧(李司棋)与丈夫黄永正(夏雨)凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风(黄宗泽)更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟(李国麟)助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华(关菊英)及亲弟梁赞(阮兆祥)大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧(米雪)有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议。可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家(王浩信)与许家独生女许贝儿(岑丽香)相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱(陈敏之)与有妇之夫郑立安(唐文龙)的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文(黄翠如)关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴……
